resources.string: Rests apps when their time is up.
Keeps Meadow from being removed on a whim.
Greyed out? In App info, tap ⋮ › Allow restricted settings.
This build of Meadow isn\'t connected to a backend yet. Add your Firebase project\'s google-services.json to the app folder, deploy the backend, then rebuild. The README walks through each step.
Quiets resting apps\' notifications and media.
Android, and many phone makers on top of it, stop apps in the background to save battery. These steps keep Meadow running on this phone. Nobody else sees how your phone is set up.
Usage access, the garden keeper and notification access need to be on first.
Choose \"Allow\" or \"Unrestricted\" for Meadow, so Android doesn\'t pause it.
In Meadow\'s app info, open Battery (or App battery usage) and allow background activity. If you see \"Pause app activity if unused\", turn it off.
Open recent apps, press and hold Meadow (or swipe it down), and choose the lock. Clearing recent apps then leaves it running.
In Security › Autostart, turn on Meadow so it starts again after a restart.
In Meadow\'s battery saver settings choose \"No restrictions\".
Under Other permissions, allow \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\" and \"Show on lock screen\", so the resting screen can appear.
In App launch, turn off \"Manage automatically\" for Meadow, then turn on auto-launch, secondary launch and run in background.
In Battery › Background usage limits, add Meadow to \"Never sleeping apps\", and make sure it isn\'t in sleeping or deep sleeping apps.
In the startup manager, allow Meadow to auto-launch. In Meadow\'s battery settings, allow background activity.
In i Manager › Background startup, allow Meadow. In battery settings, allow high background power use.
In Mobile Manager › Auto-start, allow Meadow.
Strict mode only works while Android can\'t put Meadow to sleep and the garden keeper can reach notifications. Turn those on, or turn strict mode off. Nobody else is told either way.
Strict mode needs unrestricted battery and notification access, so Meadow can\'t be put to sleep. Turn them on in Protections first.
